# Command-line interface with named run modes

The project exposes a CLI that lists and provides multiple run modes (init, compile, reconcile, verify, inspect, serve). This allows operators to interact with the system using distinct, discoverable commands via the main CLI entrypoint.

- `tests/test_smoke.py` — `tests.test_smoke.test_cli_mounts_all_run_modes`
